aiReview.summary: Official Google developer hub for Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemma, and on-device/edge tooling. High-value primary docs for generation and API work; not a Nano Banana prompt pack or ComfyUI node.

meta-description: Build with Gemini 2.0 Flash, 2.5 Pro, and Gemma using the Gemini API and Google AI Studio
Page sections: Gemini API docs, Google AI Studio, Gemma, Google AI Edge, Responsible AI
confidenceReasons include bucket:official-web and bucket:approve; riskFlags empty
uncertainty: Current paid-tier quotas and Nano Banana / Imagen model names on this hub were not fully enumerated beyond landing copy

aiReview.tagline: Official docs, API keys, and Studio for Google models
aiReview.description: Build with Google multimodal models via API and AI Studio, plus open weights, on-device edge tools, and responsible-AI guidance.
pros: Canonical Google AI for Developers site covering Gemini API docs, AI Studio, Gemma, and AI Edge.
Meta description and landing copy document API-key integration, prompt evaluation in Studio, and models including Imagen and Veo.
Includes responsible-AI guidance and links to community forum and showcases.
Rubric explicitly prefers official Gemini / AI Studio documentation over meme or closed-UI listings.
cons: Hub is general Google AI docs, not a Nano Banana prompt library or ComfyUI node pack.
Landing page mixes marketing CTAs and many product surfaces, so image-generation specifics sit deeper in docs.

aiReview.summary: Python CLI and Claude Code skill that turns documents into 16:9 PPT stills via Gemini image (Nano Banana Pro) plus optional Kling transitions and FFmpeg export. Strong fit for Nano Banana tooling, but it has no SPDX license and install prompts ask users to paste API keys into chat.
evidence: README states image generation via Google Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview) and google-genai.
README lists document analysis, two built-in styles, Kling transitions, interactive player, and FFmpeg export.
facts.license is null; stargazers_count 3248; forks_count 343; archived false.
Install section includes Claude Code prompts with GEMINI_API_KEY / KLING_* placeholders.
uncertainty: Cannot verify generation quality, prompt-library completeness, or Kling integration from README alone.
Cannot confirm SKILL.md / ARCHITECTURE.md accuracy or current API model names.
License intent and commercial reuse remain unverified.
aiReview.tagline: Gemini image PPT slides with optional Kling transitions
aiReview.description: Analyze documents, generate styled 16:9 slides with Gemini image APIs, and optionally add Kling transitions plus FFmpeg video export.
pros: Uses Google Gemini image generation (Nano Banana Pro / Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview) for 16:9 2K/4K slides.
Documents two visual prompt styles, JSON slide planning, and a generate_ppt.py CLI plus SKILL.md for Claude Code.
Optional Kling AI transitions, interactive player, and FFmpeg full-video export are described in the README.
Repository shows substantial adoption (about 3.2k stars and 340 forks) with a demo video and architecture notes.
cons: GitHub reports no license, so reuse terms are unclear.
One-click install copy-paste blocks tell users to put live GEMINI and Kling keys into a Claude Code prompt.
Image generation depends on paid/third-party Gemini and Kling keys; video features also need FFmpeg.
Last recorded push is 2026-01-19, so maintenance recency is modest relative to late 2026.

# NanoBanana PPT Skills > 基于 AI 自动生成高质量 PPT 图片和视频的强大工具，支持智能转场和交互式播放
**创作者**: [歸藏](https://github.com/op7418) [效果演示](#-效果演示) • [功能特性](#-功能特性) • [一键安装](#-一键安装) • [作为 Skill 使用](#-作为-claude-code-skill-使用) • [使用指南](#-使用指南) • [视频功能](#-视频功能) • [架构文档](ARCHITECTURE.md) • [常见问题](#-常见问题)
--- ## 🎬 效果演示
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b394de21-2848-489a-8d33-a8e262e60f60 *AI 自动生成 PPT 并添加流畅转场动画 - 从文档分析到视频合成一键完成*
--- ## 📖 简介 NanoBanana PPT Skills 是一个强大的 AI 驱动的 PPT 生成工具，能够： - 📄 **智能分析文档**，自动提取核心要点并规划 PPT 结构 - 🎨 **生成高质量图片**，使用 Google Nano Banana Pro（Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview） - 🎬 **自动生成转场视频**，使用可灵 AI 创建流畅的页面过渡动画 - 🎮 **交互式视频播放器**，支持键盘控制、循环预览、智能转场 - 🎥 **完整视频导出**，一键合成包含所有转场的完整 PPT 视频 ### 🎨 视觉风格 **渐变毛玻璃卡片风格** - 高端科技感，Apple Keynote 极简主义 - 3D 玻璃物体 + 霓虹渐变 - 电影级光照效果 - 适合：科技产品、商务演示、数据报告 **矢量插画风格** - 温暖扁平化设计，复古配色 - 黑色轮廓线 + 几何化处理 - 玩具模型般的可爱感 - 适合：教育培训、创意提案、品牌故事 --- ## ✨ 功能特性 ### 🎯 核心能力 - 🤖 **智能文档分析** - 自动提取核心要点，规划

aiReview.summary: Open-source agent skill that routes Gemini Nano Banana image and Omni Flash video jobs with cost quotes, reference-image sets, and sidecar prompt logs. Useful for Claude Code/Cursor/Antigravity workflows; small repo (few stars) and depends on a billed Google API key.
evidence: GitHub About and README: Claude Code skill for Gemini Nano Banana 2 Lite/Pro and Gemini Omni Flash with cost gates, reference images, prompt logs.
Install via npx skills add AntonioCardenas/generate-nanobanana; command /generate.
LICENSE present; topics include nanobanana, gemini, claude-code-skill.
uncertainty: Runtime correctness of Interactions API recipes and live Google pricing after August 2026.
How well agents other than Claude Code honor the skill without extra setup.
Maintenance cadence beyond 12 commits.
aiReview.tagline: Agent skill for Gemini image/video with cost gates
aiReview.description: Routes Nano Banana and Omni Flash jobs, quotes cost before billed calls, uses real reference images, and logs prompts beside outputs.
pros: Documents Gemini Nano Banana 2 Lite/2/Pro and Omni Flash with model IDs, recipes under models/, and published pricing.
Describes cost approval before billable image and video calls plus sidecar JSON next to generations.
Supports reference sets (link/import) and install via npx skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and similar agents.
MIT-licensed public repo with README, SKILL.md, Spanish README, and community files.
cons: Very small community signal (about 5 stars, 2 forks, 12 commits).
Requires GEMINI_API_KEY and billed Google API usage; generation quality is not independently demonstrated beyond one example image.
Not an official Gemini/AI Studio doc or ComfyUI node pack.

aiReview.summary: Closed SuperMaker web UI wrapping claimed Google Nano Banana APIs for text-to-image and image-to-image; credit-gated consumer generator, not a prompt library, node pack, or official docs.
evidence: Page title and editor: Nano Banana text/image modes, sizes 16:9 through 21:9, 1–4 images, required credits shown as 42 with 50% off.
Meta description: create or edit images with natural language, photos online for free.
Rubric prefers prompt libraries, maintained nodes, and official docs over closed web UIs.
uncertainty: Whether the backend is actually Gemini/Nano Banana vs a wrapper.
True free vs paid credit limits after login.
Output quality versus official Gemini Image tools.
aiReview.tagline: Credit-based web UI for Gemini-style image gen/edit
aiReview.description: Generate or edit images with text or reference photos in a browser, using aspect ratios and a credit cost per run.
pros: Offers text-to-image and image-to-image modes with selectable aspect ratios.
UI claims to be powered by the Google Nano Banana official API.
Listed in multiple awesome-nano-banana README sources.
cons: Closed commercial site with credit pricing rather than an SDK, ComfyUI node, or prompt collection.
Marketing copy is generic and unverifiable on generation quality.
No public API, source, or official Google/AI Studio documentation.

aiReview.summary: Research project page for Nano-consistent-150k, a ~159k identity-consistent image-editing dataset built with Nano Banana, with Hugging Face and GitHub links. Useful for model training more than as a prompt library or ComfyUI node.
evidence: Page title Nano Banana 150K; meta-description states a high-quality 150K image dataset using Nano Banana.
HF link huggingface.co/datasets/Yejy53/Nano-consistent-150k and GitHub yejy53/Echo plus PicoTrex/Awesome-Nano-Banana-images.
Describes Pixabay portraits filtered with GPT-5-mini, ~4k identities, 500 anime characters, and GPT-5-mini quality filtering of Nano Banana outputs.
uncertainty: Dataset license, commercial terms, and whether HF files are complete were not verified.
Fine-tuned Qwen-Image LoRA availability is not confirmed.
Identity/consent status of Pixabay and anime source images is not verified.
aiReview.tagline: 150k identity-consistent Nano Banana editing dataset
aiReview.description: Open 159k-sample identity-consistent edit dataset spanning eight tasks, with Hugging Face release and planned Qwen-Image LoRA weights.
pros: Documents 159,492 samples including ~120k single-image edits and ~40k multi-reference generations across eight sub-tasks.
Provides Hugging Face dataset and GitHub links plus methodology for identity-preserving edits.
Includes both training-oriented and user-oriented instruction formats for the same identities.
cons: It is a research dataset page, not a prompt library, editor, or ComfyUI node.
Qwen-Image LoRA weights are promised later and may not be available yet.
Source portraits include scraped Pixabay and collected anime art, so license and likeness reuse need checking.

aiReview.summary: Large community prompt library for Google Nano Banana Pro image generation, with categorized examples, preview images, and multilingual READMEs. Useful as a prompt resource; browsing and one-click generation are steered toward the YouMind commercial gallery.
evidence: GitHub description and README: curated Nano Banana Pro prompts, ~15785 listed, CC BY 4.0.
Repo includes generate-readme.ts, multilingual READMEs, and youmind.com gallery/CMS asset links.
Rubric prefers prompt collections for Nano Banana/Gemini over unrelated banana content.
uncertainty: Could not independently verify prompt quality or uniqueness of all 15k entries.
Unknown how much of the gallery requires a YouMind account or paid generation.
Community copyright provenance of individual prompts is not fully auditable from the README.
aiReview.tagline: Curated Gemini image prompts with previews and categories
aiReview.description: Collects thousands of community prompts for Google Nano Banana Pro, with previews, categories, and multilingual docs.
pros: README reports 15,000+ prompts with featured examples, preview images, and category links.
Ships 16 language README variants plus contributing, FAQ, and GitHub issue templates.
License is CC BY 4.0; some prompts include Raycast snippet-style dynamic arguments.
